lines: Added a Portraits Styles options to the Interface menu, with four distinct options: Detailed, Profile, Retro and Disabled.
Added an Inventory Effects toggle to the Interface menu (disables the item flash when crafting).
Added a Screen Shake toggle to the Video -> Effects menu.
Added a Thunder Effects toggle to the Video -> Effects menu, which disables visual flashes from lightning (does not disable lightning strikes).
Improved clipboard support on Linux.
Storm lightning strike changes:
Reduced damage to players from 200/300/400 on Classic/Expert/Master difficulty to 80/160/240. Legendary difficulty damage unchanged.
Strike delay increased from 3.5 seconds to 4 seconds.
Reduced player attachment range from three tiles to slightly less than one tile. Does not apply to Legendary difficulty.
Strikes will no longer spawn directly in the path of fast moving players.
Improved visuals of impending strike effect.
Reduced the likelihood of lightning striking bodies of water.
Strike frequency reduced when fishing, sleeping or fighting a boss.
No longer appear during blizzards.
Pylons no longer attract lightning.
Visual effect intensity reduced for players who are behind walls.
Villagers and pets now stay inside during thunderstorms.
Lightning can now strike further from the player.
Increased the appearance rate of Cattiva and Foxparks by 50%. Adjusted the ratio of 70% Cattiva - 30% Foxparks to 60% Cattiva - 40% Foxparks.
Fixed a multiplayer crash involving waterfalls.
Fixed a duplication glitch involving certain transformation mounts.
Fixed .ZIP file based resource packs no longer working.
Fixed the game being stuck in Halloween mode for the rest of the session once it becomes active. Spooky!
Fixed distressed Foxparks' mouseover hitbox being much larger than intended.
Fixed Music Boxes playing their record scratch sound effect when trying to record an unrecordable track (e.g. Rainbow Boulder).
Fixed Toybreaker Bricks not breaking Sticky Glowsticks and certain Kites.
Fixed petting, sleeping or sitting not resetting the Kite AFK timer.
Fixed sloped Rainbow Bricks not using the correct sprite.
Linux now automatically falls back to OpenGL where Vulkan is not fully supported
If the game doesn't launch/black screen, try /gldevice:OpenGL (or try repairing your Vulkan drivers)
If the audio is dropping out, try /audiodriver:pulseaudio or /audiodriver:alsa (or try repairing your pipewire drivers)
If none of those work, please submit a bug on the terraia community forums
Proton is not supported or recommended, please submit a bug report before resorting to Proton
